dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Multiple thin, high-contrast pale gray horizontal lines visible across the covert tips, though appearing as fine scalloping rather than broad solid bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale gray to white margins along the length of the folded primary and secondary feathers against dark grayish-brown centers.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and uniform scalloped pattern across the entire dorsal surface created by high-contrast white-fringe borders on dark-centered feathers.
